observations: Initial snapshot matched the reviewed baseline exactly: P 2.5/2.5/2.0, every I and D zero, centre 70/70/70, maximum 300/300/200, expo 0.50 throughout, deadband 8.
`config set roll_expo 1.1` was refused with 'roll_expo is outside the firmware-accepted range' and exit code 2; the following read still showed roll_expo 0.5.
The temporary roll profile 60 / 250 / 0.4 was persisted with verification by readback on each set, applied without a reboot or reflash, and every other value was unchanged.
The temporary profile survived a cold boot (USB unplugged and replugged) unchanged.
The exported baseline was applied back, verified by readback, and matched the reviewed values; it then survived a second cold boot unchanged.
No arming, actuator activity or storage fault occurred at any point; the battery and ESCs were disconnected throughout.

The first `config show` after the port permissions were fixed was answered `ERR invalid command; type help`. It did not recur in any later invocation, and the firmware answered the same command correctly when it was sent by hand over the raw port, so it appears to be a garbled first line on the initial open rather than a firmware fault.
Step 1 (the read-only show and export) was run by the agent at the operator's request; the operator ran every step that writes to the board and performed both cold boots.
limitations: Run on Linux with FerroConfigurator built from tools/ferro-configurator, not the released Windows package the procedure names; the port is /dev/ttyACM0 rather than a COM port.
Host port permissions required a udev rule for 16c0:27dd before the tool could open the port.
`config show` output is recorded as values in this record rather than as retained snapshot files; only the exported baseline profile is retained as an artifact.
